title: Line sketch: Swirl Liquid Vortex
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The artwork captures dynamic swirls of viscous - liquid twisting and splashing against a background. Scattered bubbles and droplets enhance the sense of energetic motion and fluidity. Smooth gradients and glossy highlights create a realistic, high-speed fluid effect in an abstract composition (derived from painting #30).
